title: Precise OpenAPI composition ordering in generated artifact evaluation

phases.objective: Verify that the registered generated-artifact runner composes authoritative precise OpenAPI contracts before generic route autofill and executes the regression before deciding readiness.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: OpenAPI autofill regression reads the registered refresh runner and executes isolated route fixtures
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The regression proves precise registry composition precedes generic autofill, registry-only paths remain authoritative, and occupied root paths fail closed.
steps: Verify the pull-request evaluator delegates to the registered refresh runner.
Verify the runner orders precise registry synchronization before generic autofill.
Verify the runner executes this regression before its canonical decision.
Exercise missing, composed, final-check, and occupied-root fixture states.
assertions: Registry-only precise paths are composed even when generic route discovery cannot find them.
Generic autofill creates only the remaining uncovered stub.
Subsequent precise and generic checks pass after composition.
An occupied conflicting root path fails closed.
The regression follows runner composition rather than deprecated inline workflow commands.

phases.objective: Surface precise-versus-generic ordering failures directly in generated-artifact canonical comments.
Exercise duplicate registry entries, malformed path-item refs, and partial composition rollback.
Observe ordering evidence on representative OpenAPI route additions.
Require precise-before-generic composition evidence for protected-branch readiness.
